initialPrompts.name: iso-000
initialPrompts.prompt:
Create ONE polished landscape 3D gameplay mockup of Facet TD. Two input images have DIFFERENT roles.
IMAGE 1 is the ABSOLUTE GEOMETRY / CAMERA / UI REFERENCE for this requested view. Match its board projection, full-board framing, marker positions, screen-upright marker labels, gem locations, cave mouth location, castle location, and UI regions. It is a coordinate-checked drawing of the same board seen from this view.
IMAGE 2 is ONLY the MATERIAL / ART-STYLE REFERENCE: grey voxel cave rock and flat slate board, crisp faceted colored gems, amber lamps, and a pale blue heart crystal in a defended castle/vault. IGNORE its camera and IGNORE its castle placement, which was incorrect. Do not copy its old environment layout.

CRITICAL CORRECTION: the only exterior castle approach begins AT THE E MARKER and continues directly to CASTLE along the exact short approach shown in Image 1. Make the join at E unmistakable, continuously paved stone, with no branches. CHECKPOINT 2 HAS NO CONNECTION TO THE CASTLE. No exit road, bridge, staircase, opening or branch is allowed beside marker 2. Keep a rock curb outside the board near 2 if useful to make the separation clear. The route order is S → 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → E → Castle. Do not introduce a marker 6.
The hostile CAVE mouth connects only to S along the shown entry approach. It and the defended Castle are at opposite diagonal world corners; they move around the screen with camera rotation. Do not keep the castle at bottom-right out of habit. Match Image 1's landmark locations exactly.

WORLD: one continuous grey cave floor around the board, no floating platform, chasm moat or bridges over voids. Keep ALL 37x37 playable cells, all four wall arms and all marker gaps; no extra playable walls. The castle is a compact grey fortified vault with one pale-blue faceted heart crystal, attached to the exact approach endpoint. Cave rock outside the board is authored voxel geometry, with modest amber lights. No tall foreground rock may hide any marker or approach. Keep the scene restrained and the light board readable. No extra enemies, towers, green terrain, green UI, lava, huge scenery crystals or decorative side roads. Gem colors: ruby red, sapphire blue and amethyst purple at source positions.
UI LOCK: charcoal top status bar; top-left 5-slot placement summary (3 filled), bottom-left selected ruby panel, bottom-right ICON-ONLY tools. Preserve labels and values from Image 1. Same clean sans-serif UI; no pixel fonts, added captions, device frames, insets, collages, dramatic lens or depth-of-field. You may omit the small angle note in the lower-left margin. Keep the small Cave and Castle landmark labels and all S,1,2,3,4,5,E labels legible. Exactly one view per output.

REQUESTED CAMERA: ISOMETRIC ORTHOGRAPHIC, elevation 35.264 degrees, camera rotation offset 0 degrees from the first view. It is a quarter-turn camera change of the SAME world, not a rotated flat screenshot.
SCREEN ANCHORS in the 1440x900 reference, measured from top-left, must remain at the same proportional positions: 1 (41.8%, 40.6%); 2 (65.1%, 62.1%); 3 (76.8%, 51.4%); 4 (65.1%, 40.6%); 5 (41.8%, 62.1%); S (53.5%, 29.8%); E (53.5%, 72.9%); Castle center (53.5%, 85.2%); Cave center (53.5%, 16.0%). The E-to-Castle approach in Image 1 is authoritative.

wallRepairPrompts.name: iso-090
wallRepairPrompts.prompt:
Make a MINIMAL corrective edit to IMAGE 1, the finished Facet TD cave mockup. IMAGE 2 is its exact board geometry guide, with darker raised blocks showing fixed walls. Keep IMAGE 1's camera, framing, landmarks, E-to-Castle connection, Cave-to-S connection, HUD, all labels and gem positions unchanged. Only repair the low fixed wall arms on the playable board.
The board MUST have FOUR short wall arms, each occupying nine cells minus the checkpoint gap: one at marker 1, one at 2, one at 4, one at 5. Each arm follows the central cross from the outside board edge inward for nine cells. Each has eight small grey voxel stone blocks, four on each side of its numbered checkpoint opening. Image 2 shows the exact positions and projection. Match them, with dark visible side faces and pale top faces. They are low walls, less than one cell high. Do not turn the full central cross into walls. Do not add a perimeter wall around the board, and remove stray low gameplay walls inside the grid that do not correspond to Image 2. Outside cave rock remains unchanged.
Wall-arm checkpoint positions as percentages of the original template: 1: 65.1% across, 40.6% down; 2: 41.8% across, 62.1% down; 4: 65.1% across, 62.1% down; 5: 41.8% across, 40.6% down.
Preserve EVERY marker S,1,2,3,4,5,E. Preserve the unbranched exit approach FROM E TO CASTLE; checkpoint 2 must not lead outside to the castle. Do not move the Castle or Cave; no new roads, portals or labels. Retain all three gems. Retain the grey modern HUD and icon-only bottom-right toolstrip. Output the same single landscape screenshot with only the wall correction, matching IMAGE 1's voxel-cave + faceted-gem art style.
